verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own library of 150+ customizable legal documents, plus formation filings it corrects if it gets them wrong. That is thin support for document-filling, but nothing shows a guided questionnaire flow or flagging of specific choices for attorney review. Its attorney consultations are a separate, adjacent service and earn no credit for in-flow flagging. Missing for 10: documented guided questionnaire that populates documents, automated flagging of choices needing attorney review, any hands-on or independent corroboration of document accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review
